cohort: All randomized users with a supplied replay trigger and an observed first-trigger anchor; assignment-level analysis.
anchor: Each viewer's first trigger delivery, recorded before agent action; identical outcome windows in both arms.
paid_cohort: First-paid purchase uses only supported never-paid viewers at baseline (paid_at_baseline=false); known paid and unknown baseline histories are excluded before treatment.

any_play_7d.ci_method: Unadjusted independent-binomial normal approximation; descriptive, no multiplicity correction.

episode_completion_7d.ci_method: Unadjusted independent-binomial normal approximation; descriptive, no multiplicity correction.

first_paid_purchase_7d.ci_method: Unadjusted independent-binomial normal approximation; descriptive, no multiplicity correction.

three_play_days_14d.ci_method: Unadjusted independent-binomial normal approximation; descriptive, no multiplicity correction.

interpretation: Randomized intention-to-treat estimates in this synthetic simulator, not evidence of production effectiveness or individual causality.

pilot.ci_method: Unadjusted independent-binomial normal approximation; descriptive, no multiplicity correction.
pilot.note: The internal served-vs-everyone-else headline conditions on post-randomization exposure and is selection biased; it does not justify rollout.

provider_mode: Keyless deterministic replay with injected faults; not live model performance.
